provenance: User requested usable starting values. Values marked heuristic are simulation choices, not official dVRK hardware parameters or a fit to grasp5.bag.

geometry.provenance: Retain historical DRENDS geometry for this initial trial; correspondence to grasp5 is unverified. Do not substitute old test project extrinsics.

provenance.focus_distance_m: selected to match the first preview tool-tip axial depth of 0.100 m, not recovered real focus

derived_intermediate_render.warning: These are the overscanned intermediate camera values, not the measured physical sensor dimensions. Preserve the existing K/D ray map.

field_blur.radial_definition: r = distance from each output pixel to that eye principal point / maximum such distance over the four image corners; clamp to [0,1]
field_blur.application: after geometric distortion mapping, before noise, same law in both eyes; do not change object pose labels

noise.model: heuristic signal-dependent Gaussian approximation in final encoded RGB DN, not physical shot/read sensor calibration
noise.final_quantization: add noise in floating point DN, round and clip to [0,255]

illumination.provenance: Base white-reference RGB scales retained; effective response includes source x16 and global x0.75, total x12. These effective scales already include the global adjustment. Not hardware gain or exposure.

timing.provenance: Initial timing assumption; not measured from bag. Frame rate does not imply this exposure time.
timing.warning: Exposure time alone does not set brightness in the existing pipeline. Moving-scene capture must implement shutter integration separately; static screenshots do not validate capture FPS.

initial_tuning_controls.rule: Change only the relevant control for each comparison; keep optics, lighting and color fixed across a stereo pair.

field_edge_attenuation.source: User explicitly requested outer linear gain 3.5 percent and an additional 25 percent overall brightness reduction; use linear RGB multiplier 0.75. Oval and transition retained. These are effect settings, not measured hardware parameters.
field_edge_attenuation.application: linear RGB before sRGB encoding and sensor noise
field_edge_attenuation.change: Outer mask gain 0.025 -> 0.035, then global linear multiplier 0.75. Effective central gain 0.75 and outer gain 0.02625 relative to source response. No ellipse or transition changes.

configuration_acceptance.scope: User-approved visual configuration and numerical settings for subsequent image generation; not a real-camera calibration claim.
configuration_acceptance.user_confirmation: 不错，非常完美，就按照这个数值，然后更新文档
configuration_acceptance.future_generation_rule: Use these values as the default baseline; record any later requested changes in a new output run.

processing_order: existing native DoF HDR -> distortion map (already in cache) -> existing field blur -> source fixed RGB x16 response -> border_3p5_global075 elliptical gain -> global linear x0.75 (effective RGB x12) -> sRGB -> original noise model and seeds -> uint8

global_brightness_adjustment.application: Applied once after mask in generator, BEFORE sRGB/noise. Already folded into effective illumination scales below; do not apply a second time when using these scales.
